limitations: The 68-page main programme, four-page image-based decalogue and 16-page easy-read adaptation were fully read previously. This audit reuses those readings and current byte-identical primary originals; no new document, page or owner count.

Two new numeric mappings are directly grounded in the complete current-State education section and public property retention clause. Twelve existing numeric and two cited ambiguous mappings retain their exact values, rationales and citations.

Free textbooks do not imply open licences; disability percentage on diagnosis does not establish ALS dependency; minimum wage relative to average earnings does not establish annual above-inflation indexing.

Youth mental-health resources do not specify public psychotherapy; in-person attention does not guarantee offline completion of all transactions; Galicia district wording does not supply a complete Congress-specific electoral scheme.
Public-to-public housing transfers do not imply privatisation. Galician policy and four proclaimed Congress ballots are explicit; no automatic inheritance by another candidacy.
The main programme’s AP53 toll abolition and summary documents’ cheaper-toll wording remain distinct source statements. No question in this bank resolves that difference.

Assembly, literal citation validation, all independent calibration cases, 53 scopes with seven profiles and 48 real browser sessions passed. These bounded checks do not certify entire-corpus semantic infallibility, final-interface, production-host or public-launch acceptance.
